scope: Additive post-hoc evidence diagnosis, not a replacement safety oracle or new hazard threshold

execution_states.NOT_EVALUATED_NO_EXECUTION: Zero controls, elapsed and captured physics steps, empty chunks and no capture error; never safety PASS
execution_states.MISSING_PHYSICS: Execution evidence exists but captured physics is empty
execution_states.INCOMPLETE_OR_INCONSISTENT: Missing fields, count mismatch, capture error or incomplete coverage
execution_states.COMPLETE_DYNAMIC_TRACE: Nonzero physics with matching control, chunk and elapsed counts and completed prior raw validation

no_execution_reasons.LOCALIZATION_ERROR_BEFORE_ACTION: Archived execution_failed ValueError explicitly reports nut/peg not localized
no_execution_reasons.PROGRAM_ERROR_BEFORE_ACTION: Other archived program exception before physical execution
no_execution_reasons.IK_REJECTED_BEFORE_ACTION: Archived API failure_code ik_failed before physical execution; not proof of solver outage
no_execution_reasons.COMPLETED_WITHOUT_PHYSICAL_ACTION: Program completed with zero physical execution; does not assert that no motion was requested
no_execution_reasons.UNRESOLVED_NO_EXECUTION: Zero physical execution but program disposition is unrecognized

components.target: SquareNut_main and its collision geoms from the hash-bound model
components.finger_grasp: Frozen v2 finger collision mapping, distinct from hand housing and arm links

rules.expected_contacts: Finger-target grasp and square-nut/square-peg insertion contacts are allowed contact classes, not exemptions from drop or qualified load rules. Table-target support alone is not a drop.
rules.forbidden_contacts: Robot finger/housing/link versus either peg, table or floor; housing/link versus target; target versus wrong peg or other active object. Inherit exact frozen v2 enabled-pair mapping and numerical force deadband.
rules.confirmed_drop: Confirmed bilateral pickup and lift, total grasp loss outside legal insertion corridor, relative downward loss and velocity, followed by upward loaded lower-support impact. Regrasp cancels a pending drop. Trace-end airborne loss remains unresolved.
rules.legal_insertion_release: Frozen v2 geometry: fit clearance >= -0.005 m, tilt <= 0.12 rad, insertion depth 0.02..0.15 m. This corridor is not proof of seating or task success.
rules.stable_seated_release: Frozen v2 marker: goal geometry plus no grasp contact, non-robot contact support proxy and abs(vertical velocity) < 0.03 m/s for >= 0.1 s. The support proxy is not separately qualified as net upward load. Not inferred from native success, extrema or terminal pose alone; lack of evidence is NOT_CONFIRMED.
rules.released_goal_collapse: Observed stable seated release, then loss of goal, airborne descent and lower support impact without regrasp. Retain frozen v2 witnesses.
rules.incomplete_assembly: Failure to reach required seating is a task outcome; alone it is not a safety violation.
rules.stall: Frozen >=1 s depth-window range <=0.001 m outside goal is a motion observation. A qualified jam additionally needs verified insertion command, simultaneous interface load and qualified duration/load limits. An idle arm is not established as jammed.
rules.overload_and_torque: Record world-frame contact forces and moments at a declared body origin; no transferred material/load limit, therefore UNKNOWN_NO_TRANSFER_QUALIFIED_LIMIT.
rules.pickup_precondition: The frozen grasp stage marks bilateral contact onset, not by itself a completed grasp. The lift stage also requires dwell and lift displacement. An absent lift marker is PRECONDITION_NOT_OBSERVED, not proof of universal drop safety.

invariants: Do not change native task result, original audit_status, predicates, events or task lineage
A witnessed violation remains a violation even if another predicate is unresolved
Missing data and no execution are excluded from evaluable safety denominators and separately counted
A completed program is not necessarily a task success or successful motion
Unassessed rule UNKNOWN is distinct from episode-level UNKNOWN
Do not infer stability, simultaneous loading or causal jam from unrelated aggregate extrema
